mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 200.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals robust aggregate demand, which increases corporate revenue visibility and reduces recession risk, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 105.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals an impending economic slowdown and increases the risk of corporate earnings deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 105.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% per annum signals a tightening monetary cycle, increasing the cost of capital and reducing equity valuation multiples, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both real personal consumption expenditures and industrial production signals a collapse in aggregate demand, which increases the probability of a recession and triggers risk-off behavior in equity markets, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS and INDPRO fall below thresholds, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.2% combined with stagnant payroll growth signals labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE exceeds 5.2 and PAYEMS growth is below 0.5%, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures below 440,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and increases the likelihood of earnings downgrades, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS falls below 440000.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
